candidates.name: Cologne Bonn cargo apron, FedEx hub
candidates.coordinate_confidence: Approximate airport scene anchor; camera mount and view alignment unverified.
candidates.quality_reason: Direct view of the clearly branded FedEx building and parked FedEx aircraft, with ground service vehicles changing position. Strong relevance, but the source is only 640x480 and aircraft activity varies.

quality_evidence.source: Official cargo webcam browser observations at video times 25.207601 and 120.937614 seconds.
quality_evidence.observations: FedEx logo visible on hub building and aircraft; foreground service truck and equipment positions change between observations. Public airport page explicitly identifies FedEx building.

validation.method: Official browser HLS playback with currentTime advancing, readyState4; playlist HTTP200 and CORS wildcard.
validation.limitations: Desktop browser verification; no ET401 hardware test.

candidates.notes: Public airport-operated cargo camera directly overlooking FedEx; other carriers and terminal ground activity also appear. Preserve source resolution; do not label HD.
candidates.source_provenance: Official airport webcam caption: Blick auf das Cargo Vorfeld und dem Fedex Gebaeude.

research_notes: Minneapolis-St. Paul MNCam wWm-kbryDDQ plays live at1080p. Camscape identifies a FedEx loading-bay view, but the current observed stream uses a split-screen airport/cargo view; FedEx-specific angle not personally confirmed. Retained as a lead, not admitted here.

Indianapolis, Anchorage, Oakland and Paris-CDG were searched. No additional verified public camera directly showing a FedEx facility found in this bounded pass. Lake Hood is already in the app and is a seaplane view, not a verified FedEx ramp camera.
FedExForum search surfaced obsolete2003 construction-camera coverage, not a current live source.
